name: The Angel
source: Potato Desk Heaven Steps, storyboards/series/potato-desk/heaven-steps/DESIGN.md section 1 (variant A, Jonny's pick) and the concept sheet heaven-steps-concept-v1.png
personality: The deadpan clerk of Heaven (Potato Desk, Heaven Steps): slow, dry, never raises his voice, writes the minus before he says it. A white potato-angel in a wrap robe with a rope belt, small wings, a floating halo and low round gold glasses he looks over.
voiceNote: dry, slow, low-mid registry clerk, no rise on a question, a half-second of nothing before each number (a proposal until Jonny has heard it)
notes: Standing 1.34 m (Chip 0.67), sprout tip 1.50, halo top 1.63. Costume keys (flap, slip, tilt, wings, robe colours) are documented in the header of engine/page/costumes-angel.js. The right hand is left free for the quill. Skin specks and freckles are drawn by the kit (the body's own specks are off).
